title: The Priestly Blessing
description: The Lord spoke to Moses and gave Aaron and his sons a specific blessing they were to pronounce over the Israelites: 'The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you; the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.' In this way, the priests place the name of the Lord upon the people, and the Lord promises to bless them. [ref:Num 6:22-27|Numbers 6:22-27]
